decision: Selected the centroid of the ALKIS-BW building whose location key is Schickardstraße 19, Böblingen (the operator's STR001 address) as the project locator.

computed.crs: CRS84 as served by the OGC API Features endpoint (storage CRS EPSG:25832 per the collection metadata)
computed.method: shapely polygon centroid on the served CRS84 coordinates; areas and distances in EPSG:25832 via pyproj

identity_bridge: AtlasEdge Stuttgart page: 'STR001 (In operation)', Schickardstraße 19, 71034 Böblingen, Germany.

The same page's footer links 'Stuttgart, Schickardstraße 19, 71034 Böblingen' to maps.app.goo.gl/etPb8GKJCq5v51er9, which resolves to the Google Maps place 'AtlasEdge Data Centres | Stuttgart' at 48.6757596, 8.9669419 (!3d/!4d, repeated in the payload).
LGL street catalogue: Böblingen (08115003) street key 01885 = Schickardstraße; ALKIS-BW building lage_id 08115003018850019000 therefore carries Schickardstraße 19.

ancillary_structures_same_address_key.note: Linked to the same street and house number without an address of their own; excluded from the footprint.

consistency_checks.other_addressed_building_in_query_box: Apothekerstraße 5 (street key 00587), about 161 m north-west of the place point; not the operator's address.

transform_check: No CRS transformation was needed for the locator (served in CRS84); pyproj EPSG:4326 -> EPSG:25832 used only for areas and distances.

excluded_coordinates.reason: Corroborates the address (inside the same parcel, 8.6 m from the footprint) but is a commercial map marker; the official building footprint is preferred.
